src/main/java/com/gachaman/ui/panel/Over.summary: `clientThread.invokeLater(taskService::presentOffers)` silently binds to the `invokeLater(BooleanSupplier)` overload, not `invokeLater(Runnable)`. `presentOffers()` returns false when state is null or pendingOffers is null/empty, and RuneLite re-queues a supplier that returns false, retrying it EVERY game tick forever. A 'View Rolled Contracts' click that lands after the offers are cleared (party-roll cancel, TTL expiry, world hop, accept via the ceremony overlay) leaks a permanent tick task that will fire `ceremonyBus.submit(TASK_OFFERS, ...)` the next time any offer set exists -- popping the offer ceremony unprompted, possibly stacked on the fresh roll's own ceremony. Fix: force the Runnable overload with a block lambda, `e -> clientThread.invokeLater(() -> { taskService.presentOffers(); })`. Note a zero-arg expression lambda `() -> taskService.presentOffers()` does NOT fix it (a zero-parameter lambda counts as explicitly typed, so the same most-specific rule applies); the braces are load-bearing. This is the only such call in the repo -- `rollOffers` returns List and `openSlotChest` returns ChestOpenResult, both of which bind to Runnable; `loadoutTabButton::create`/`::remove` are void.
